descriptor: An AI agent to fill last-minute hygienist shift gaps across three dental offices.

requirements.statement: The system must read call-out texts or emails the moment they arrive and open a 'gap' for the office, date, and hours.
The system must rank hygienists to offer the shift based on being off that day, licensed for that office, under 40 hours that week, and nearest by commute.
The system must text shift offers in waves of three people, with a 10-minute window to reply YES.
The system must update the shared schedule in Google Sheets and notify the front desk via Slack.
The system must page Dana with the gap and the list of who was asked if nobody accepts by 7:30.
The system must never offer a shift that would push someone over 40 hours without Dana approving overtime.
The system must never text a hygienist who is on approved leave.
The system must never share one employee's reason for calling out with anyone else.
The system must send Dana a summary at the end of the day.
The system must spread shift offers more fairly among hygienists.
The system must use Gmail, Slack, Google Sheets, and Twilio SMS for communication and data handling.

stories.title: Create Gap from Call-out
stories.narrative: As a scheduler, I want to create a gap when a hygienist calls out, so that the system can manage shift offers.
acceptance: Given a hygienist calls out, when I record the call-out, then a gap is created in the schedule.
Given a gap is created, when the system ranks hygienists, then the ranking considers availability, licensing, hours, and commute.
Trust: Given a gap is created, when the system logs the event, then the audit trail records the gap creation and ranking process.
stories.task_guidance: Implement the gap creation logic and integrate the ranking algorithm to consider the specified criteria.

stories.title: Ensure Compliance with Overtime and Leave
stories.narrative: As an operations manager, I want the system to ensure compliance with overtime and leave policies, so that no unauthorized offers are made.
acceptance: Given a shift offer is being prepared, When a hygienist is on approved leave, Then the system does not send an offer to them.
Given a shift offer is being prepared, When a hygienist would exceed 40 hours, Then the system requires Dana's approval before sending.
Trust: The system logs all compliance checks and approvals.
stories.task_guidance: Implement checks against the schedule and leave records before sending offers.

stories.title: Send Shift Offers to Hygienists
stories.narrative: As an operations manager, I want the system to send shift offers to hygienists, so that shifts can be filled quickly.
acceptance: Given a gap is open, When the system ranks hygienists, Then it sends offers to the top three ranked hygienists.
Given a hygienist replies YES, When within the 10-minute window, Then the system confirms the shift is filled.
Trust: The system logs all offers sent and responses received.
stories.task_guidance: Use Twilio SMS to send offers and handle responses, ensuring timing and logging are accurate.

stories.title: Escalate Unfilled Gaps to Dana
stories.narrative: As an operations manager, I want the system to escalate unfilled gaps to me, so that I can take manual action if needed.
acceptance: Given a gap is open, When no responses are received by 7:30, Then the system pages Dana with details.
Given a gap is escalated, When Dana receives the page, Then she sees the list of who was asked.
Trust: The system logs all escalations and pages sent.
stories.task_guidance: Implement a paging system to notify Dana via Slack or SMS when escalation is needed.

stories.title: Update Schedule and Notify Front Desk
stories.narrative: As an operations manager, I want the system to update the schedule and notify the front desk, so that everyone is informed of shift changes.
acceptance: Given a shift is filled, When the system confirms it, Then it updates the Google Sheets schedule.
Given a shift is filled, When the system confirms it, Then it sends a notification to the front desk via Slack.
Trust: The system logs all schedule updates and notifications sent.
stories.task_guidance: Integrate with Google Sheets API for schedule updates and Slack API for notifications.

stories.title: Send End-of-Day Summary to Dana
stories.narrative: As an operations manager, I want the system to send me a summary at the end of the day, so that I can review the day's activities.
acceptance: Given the day ends, When the system compiles data, Then it sends a summary to Dana.
Given a summary is sent, When Dana reviews it, Then it includes gaps, fill times, and overtime approvals.
Trust: The system logs all summaries sent and their contents.
stories.task_guidance: Compile data from the day's activities and format it into a summary email for Dana.

stories.title: Implement Fairness in Offer Distribution
stories.narrative: As an operations manager, I want the system to distribute offers more fairly, so that no hygienist is overburdened.
acceptance: Given a shift offer is being prepared, When the system checks past acceptances, Then it adjusts the ranking to spread offers fairly.
Given a shift offer is sent, When fairness adjustments are applied, Then the system logs the adjustment reason.
Trust: The system logs all fairness adjustments and their outcomes.
stories.task_guidance: Analyze past acceptance data to adjust rankings and ensure fair distribution of offers.

stories.title: Final System Enhancements
stories.narrative: As an operations manager, I want the system to be robust and efficient, so that it operates smoothly under all conditions.
acceptance: Given the system is running, When enhancements are applied, Then it operates without errors.
Given enhancements are applied, When the system is tested, Then all functionalities work as expected.
Trust: The system logs all enhancement applications and their effects.
stories.task_guidance: Review system performance and apply enhancements to improve efficiency and robustness.
